name: Continual Starfall grants haste for a flare absorbed to nothing
contract: This is the regression case for the damage condition removed from the Continual Starfall branch in AscensionStarcallerAbilities.cpp's AllSpellScript::OnSpellHitResult. The branch previously read 'id == 800507 && damage && player->HasAura(503584)'. That damage is the scriptDamageResult Spell::_cast passes to the hook, taken from Unit::DealSpellDamage, so it is the damage actually dealt after absorption. Continual Starfall 503584 states the haste outright for a flare landing, with no damage condition, so a flare absorbed to zero still landed and must still grant it. An absorb, not an immunity, is what produces a landing hit for no damage: a genuine immunity is classified by Unit::SpellHitResult as SPELL_MISS_IMMUNE and the handler returns on any miss, so immune targets correctly grant nothing and are out of scope. Power Word: Shield 48066 rank 14 is SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB (69) with EffectBasePoints 2229 and DieSides 1 resolving to 2230 absorbed over its 30 s duration. 800507 'Aspect of the Stars [Damage]' is the spell every Astral Flare triggers (502318-502324 and 800499 carry SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE on it), so casting it directly is what a flare does. Fixtures: 800507 carries EffectBasePoints 0 and takes its damage from coefficients on spell power, so an ungeared caster deals almost nothing and the shield would prove little; measured against an ungeared level 80 creature the flare took exactly 9 health, so the caster is given spell_power 5000 and the bare control confirms the result lands as real damage well inside the 2230 the shield can swallow. The creature fixture cannot carry an aura (its fields are id, owner, entry, distance, faction, level, health, reaction, spell_hit_bonus and stationary) and set_aura reaches only the player, a pet or a summoned creature, so both targets are hostile players of the opposing faction with PvP enabled. The scenario location teleports every actor to one spot, without which player fixtures do not share line of sight and the cast is refused with SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS. The bare victim proves the flare deals damage at all, which is what makes the shielded victim's unchanged health evidence of absorption rather than of a spell that does nothing; 503585 stacking from 1 to 2 across the two flares is the behaviour under test.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture: cast the flare's damage directly
SETUP: the talent's passive is applied
Only the second victim carries an absorb
SETUP: the absorb is up on the shielded victim
SETUP: the bare victim carries no absorb
A flare lands on the bare victim
CONTROL: the flare does deal damage
CONTROL: a damaging flare grants haste
A flare lands on the shielded victim
The absorb swallows the whole hit
A flare absorbed to nothing still grants haste
